author: resepignev
body:
Heeya resepignev here,

Well, Trexychan just thought about why there are so many "who is the best pvper" threads and no threads about the best builders of the network.

So that's why I want to make this kind of thread.

But there are some rules:
-Don't harass someone in this thread, it's all about opinions,
-Don't suggest yourself, unless you want to look selfish,
-Please go into detail, give details why the user/player is the best builder of Avicus,
-More Rules will be added...

A little sidenote, mapdevs aren't excluded, but we all know that they can build well and that's fantastic!

So begin...
